title: Double Descent and Malign Overfitting in Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.26392v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional wisdom in deep learning holds that overparameterization---having more parameters $p$ than training samples $n$---is benign: larger models generalize better and, even without regularization, interpolating models generalize well, the test error following a double-descent curve. One might expect the same benign overfitting for diffusion models, whose training reduces to regression, i.e. to minimizing a quadratic score-matching loss. Yet the opposite is observed: overfitting here is catastrophic, driving the model into a memorization regime. We resolve this paradox by combining experiments on U-Nets trained on CelebA with a random-features model for which we derive closed-form learning curves. We show that with a fixed number $m$ of noise realizations per training sample, an interpolation peak does occur, but at $p\sim nm$ rather than at $p\sim n$ as in standard regression. translated_title: 扩散模型中的双下降与恶性过拟合
translated_abstract: 深度学习中的传统观念认为，过参数化——即参数数量 $p$ 多于训练样本数量 $n$——是无害的：更大的模型泛化能力更好，即使没有正则化，插值模型也能良好泛化，测试误差呈现双下降曲线。人们可能期望扩散模型也具有同样的良性过拟合，因为扩散模型的训练可归结为回归问题，即最小化二次分数匹配损失。然而观察到的结果恰恰相反：扩散模型中的过拟合是灾难性的，会使模型进入记忆化状态。我们通过结合在 CelebA 数据集上训练 U-Net 的实验，以及一个推导出闭式学习曲线的随机特征模型，解决了这一悖论。我们证明，当每个训练样本的噪声实现数量 $m$ 固定时，确实会出现插值峰值，但该峰值出现在 $p\sim nm$ 处，而不是像标准回归中那样出现在 $p\sim n$ 处。然而，测试损失的上升开始得要早得多。
tldr: 扩散模型存在恶性过拟合：插值峰值出现在参数量约为样本数与噪声实现数乘积（$p\sim nm$）处，且测试损失早在峰值之前就已开始恶化，这与标准回归中的良性过拟合截然相反。
en_tdlr: Diffusion models exhibit malign overfitting: the interpolation peak occurs at $p\sim nm$ rather than $p\sim n$, and test loss degrades much earlier, in stark contrast to the benign overfitting observed in standard regression.
